app.name: Party Admin
app.tagline: Create Beautiful Party Invitations & Manage Events

hero.title: Create Beautiful Party Invitations in Minutes
hero.subtitle: Free online party invitation maker and event management tool. Design custom invites, track RSVPs, and manage everything in one place.

features.title: Everything You Need to Plan Your Perfect Event
features.subtitle: Professional event management tools, completely free

customDesigner.title: Custom Invite Designer
customDesigner.description: Create stunning party invitations with our drag-and-drop designer. Customize colors, fonts, images, and layouts to match your event theme perfectly.

inviteManagement.title: Easy Invite Management
inviteManagement.description: Send invitations via email, track RSVPs, manage guest lists, and handle seat confirmations all in one place. Never lose track of your guests again.

qrCode.title: QR Code & URL Generation
qrCode.description: Generate unique QR codes and shareable URLs for your invitations. Make it easy for guests to RSVP and request additional seats instantly.

eventInfo.title: Event Information Hub
eventInfo.description: Share important details with your guests including nearby hotels, restaurants, attractions, and transportation options. Everything they need in one place.

templates.title: Beautiful Templates
templates.description: Choose from our collection of professionally designed templates or create your own from scratch. Save custom templates for future events.

rsvpTracking.title: RSVP Tracking
rsvpTracking.description: Real-time RSVP tracking with automatic updates. Know exactly who's coming, who's pending, and how many seats are confirmed.
